rita: Quick smoke notes from today ran speculative decode on quant-13b-q4 with small candidate pool. Posting raw thread so we can iterate.
rita: Run details: pool=3, fastpath=int8-13b, fallback=fp16-13b, entropy_thresh=2.8, samples=1500 (eng dev set).
sam: numbers?
rita: median latency fastpath-only ~3.1x speedup vs baseline fp16. end-to-end (including rescoring) ~2.5x. tail (p95) improved ~1.9x.
noah: quality? any regressions?
rita: Auto metrics: MMLU delta -0.9% (paired), ANLI drop small and not significant. SQuAD EM -1.1% (marginal). Human spot check (50 pairs) flagged 6 cases where fastpath truncated chains of thought.
sam: truncation expected with greedy-ish fastpath. Did you try length-normalized scoring or forcing min length?
rita: Not yet. Also saw one case where all fastpath candidates agreed on a wrong named-entity; rescorer (cheap fp16 scorer over candidates) fixed it. That suggests candidate diversity matters more than entropy alone.
noah: Could use pairwise-kl as an extra trigger. Low entropy but high inter-candidate-kl -> fallback.
sam: Agreed. Can you paste command?
rita: ```
redwood-evals run --suite smoke:v1 \
  --model quant-13b-q4_spec --fallback fp16-13b \
  --spec-candidates 3 --entropy-thresh 2.8 \
  --samples 1500 --tag spec-smoke-03
```
ci-bot: Job created: jd-4983. Artifacts: /artifacts/spec/1887654321/
ops-bot: Created ticket RED-2230: "spec-decode quick smoke + KL trigger prototype"
rita: Next steps I propose: 1) add pairwise KL and length ratio heuristics to trigger logic, 2) run 10k multilingual holdout, 3) add 5% canary on dedicated, 4) collect token logits for 1% of traffic.
sam: I'll own KL prototype. noah take canary routing?
noah: Yep. Also suggest gating rollout: block if MMLU drops >1.0% with p<0.01 or hallucination-rate for rare-entity questions increases >0.5%.
rita: Sounds good. I'll open a PR with eval configs and upload artifacts. :+1:
